backup.noRestorePointsSearch: No restore points match your search.
backup.noRestorePointsDesc: Create a restore point to preserve your system state. You can restore your system to any point when needed.
backup.betaFeature: Listing restore points is a beta feature and may be unreliable, but creating restore points works as expected.
backup.confirmRestoreDesc: Are you sure you want to restore your system to "{{name}}"? Your PC will restart shortly. and the restore point will be applied. Your files will not be affected, but recently installed applications and settings may be lost. This will revert all changes sparkle has made to your system since this restore point was created.
backup.mayTakeAWhile: This may take a while depending on your hardware
backup.deleteAllDesc: Are you sure you want to delete all {{count}} restore point{{plural}}? This action cannot be undone and will remove all system restore points from your computer.
backup.failedLoadRestore: Failed to load restore points. Please check logs
backup.restoreStarted: System restore started. Your PC may restart.
backup.enterNameError: Please enter a name for the restore point.
backup.noAppliedTweaksDesc: You don't have any tweaks applied. Go to the Tweaks page to apply some.
backup.whyNotReversible: Why are some tweaks not reversible?
backup.whyNotReversibleDesc1: Some tweaks make changes that can't be automatically reversed by Sparkle. However, most of these changes can still be undone manually:
backup.debloatingWindowsDesc: Removed apps can be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store
backup.optimizeNvidiaDesc: Settings can be reset through the NVIDIA Control Panel
backup.serviceModsDesc: Services can be re-enabled through Windows Services Manager
backup.whyNotReversibleDesc2: While these tweaks don't have an automatic undo button, you can always create a restore point before applying them.
backup.tipNonReversible: Tip: Create a restore point before applying non-reversible tweaks so you have an easy fallback option.
backup.confirmUndoAllDesc: Are you sure you want to undo all {{count}} applied tweak{{plural}}? This will run the unapply script for each tweak and may require a restart.
backup.undoScriptNote: Note: Some undo scripts reinstall apps, so this process may take a while.

utilities.whatsNew: What's New in the Utilities Page
utilities.redesigned: We've redesigned the Utilities page to be more useful and powerful.
utilities.feature1: Each utility now shows detailed descriptions and has new controls like toggles, buttons, or dropdowns.
utilities.feature2: Utilities run or apply settings directly using PowerShell scripts behind the scenes.
utilities.feature3: The settings sync with your Windows always reflecting your current configuration no matter where you toggle these settings.
utilities.feature4: You can now manage Windows updates, restart graphics drivers, reset network, and more.
utilities.diskCleanerDesc: Free up space by removing unnecessary files.
utilities.storageSenseDesc: Automatically free up space by getting rid of files you don't need.
utilities.sysInfoDesc: View detailed information about your system.
utilities.fastStartupDesc: Improve boot times by optimizing startup settings.
utilities.graphicsDriverDesc: Restart your graphics driver to fix display issues.
utilities.winSearchUIDesc: Restart your Windows Search and UI to fix display issues. (May take a while)
utilities.powerPlanDesc: Choose how your computer manages power and performance.
utilities.flushDNSDesc: Fix connection issues by clearing DNS resolver cache.
utilities.releaseIPDesc: Release your current IP address and disconnect from the network temporarily.
utilities.renewIPDesc: Request a new IP address from the DHCP server.
utilities.fixBluetoothDesc: Restart Bluetooth services to resolve connectivity issues.
utilities.sfcDesc: Repair corrupted system files to improve stability.
utilities.dismDesc: Use DISM to repair the Windows image and fix system issues.
utilities.checkDiskDesc: Check and fix disk errors on your system.
utilities.restartAudioDesc: Fix sound issues by restarting Windows Audio.
utilities.networkResetDesc: Reset your network stack to fix connectivity problems.

settings.animationDesc: Choose the page transition animation direction
settings.defaultPkgManagerDesc: Set the default package manager for installing apps
settings.hideAppIcons: Hide App Icons on Apps Page
settings.hideAppIconsDesc: Hides the app icons on the apps page, showing only the app names. Reduces network requests and speeds up loading time, especially on slower connections.
settings.forceLocalAppsDesc: By default, the apps page fetches the latest "apps.json" from github. Enabling this option forces it to use the local version of "apps.json" which is updated with Sparkle updates.
settings.legacyBackupsDesc: Remove old backup files stored in C:\Sparkle\Backup
settings.deleteLegacyDesc: Are you sure you want to delete all legacy registry backups? This will permanently remove the C:\Sparkle\Backup folder and all its contents.
settings.clearSparkleCacheDesc: Remove temporary files/logs Sparkle may leave behind.
settings.showTrayDesc: Enable or disable Sparkle running in the system tray.
settings.restartExplorerDesc: Restarts Windows Explorer and Taskbar. Useful if the taskbar disappears.
settings.devWarning: It is not recommended to modify these options unless you are a developer or contributor.
settings.resetPkgModalDesc: Reset the package manager modal located on the apps page to appear on next visit
settings.pkgModalReset: Package manager modal will be shown on next visit
settings.openDevtoolsDesc: Open the developer tools for debugging. Not recommended for regular users.
